tei:div.tei:p: All will come to serve Thee and praise Thy glorious Name, They will proclaim among the islands Thy righteousness: Peoples that did not know Thee will seek Thee, and all the ends of the earth will praise Thee and constantly will they say: ‘great is the Lord’. To Thee will they offer their sacrifices they will abandon their idols and grow ashamed of their images. They will incline their shoulders in unison to serve Thee. At sunrise there will stand before Thee full of awe those who seek Thy countenance. They will acknowledge the power of Thy Kingdom, teach understanding to those who have strayed, talk of Thy might and raise Thee exalted supreme above all. Trembling will they appear before Thy countenance and crown Thee with a glorious crown so that the mountains will burst out in jubilation and the islands rejoice in Thy rule. They will accept the yoke of Thy Kingdom upon themselves, exalt Thee in the assembly of the people, those far away will hear and come and hand Thee the crown of the Kingdom.
